narrative:
## Handover Summary — Carrier & Termination Cost

Committed route savings are locked by product and market.

## Key Decisions
• International wholesale re-routed to direct operator binds
• Central Europe Enterprise SMS consolidated to reach next volume tier
• AIT blocking on 9 OTP destinations via SMS Firewall

## Recommendation for Pricing & Channel Mix
Nordic operator price rises are only partly offset by routing. Pricing must pass through the remainder to protect GP per message.

## Risk Factors
• Operator contract timing (Q1 renegotiation windows)
• Quality-of-delivery risk on new direct routes

signals.title: Least-cost routing model — Q3 run
signals.excerpt: Direct operator binds undercut hub aggregators by 6-9% on 14 international destinations.

signals.title: Nordic operators announce A2P termination increases
signals.excerpt: Telenor, Telia and Telia Finland notify 5-7% A2P SMS termination increases effective 1 January 2026.
